matches.reason: It writes emails to customers and is approved for contact details, but a rep sends each one; it doesn't reply on its own.

bullets.label: Sends on its own
bullets.text: Yes. The request is for replies to go out right away with no one reading them first. Northstar doesn't approve tools that send to customers on their own.

bullets.label: Information
bullets.text: Customer contact details from the inbound demo form. Replies would go to prospects as soon as the form is filled in.

bullets.label: Closest match
bullets.text: Call Recap Writer writes customer emails and is approved for contact details, but a rep reads and sends each one.

bullets.label: Worth asking
bullets.text: Would a reply drafted within minutes, for a rep to check and send, solve the slow response time?

not_approved.reason: This would send emails to people who asked for a demo without anyone reading them first, and it uses contact details from our inbound form. We don't approve tools that send to customers on their own.
not_approved.what_would_change: A version that drafts each reply for a rep to check and send would likely be approved.
